display_title: AI chip demonstrators for EU compute infrastructure (DIGITAL-JU-CHIPS-2026-AI1-SG) – Digital Europe Programme
call_title: AI chip demonstrators for EU compute infrastructure (DIGITAL-JU-CHIPS-2026-AI1-SG)
executive_summary: Funds working AI chip demonstrators (chip on a printed circuit board, integrated with its software stack) by EU fabless chip design companies, benchmarked on the common EU evaluation platform; the best receive an AI Compute Excellence label needed for later rack development. Each consortium must include at least one EU-established fabless AI chip design company. Simple Grants co-funded with national funding authorities, EU rate up to 50%; EU contribution up to EUR 1 million per project, EUR 10 million for about 10 projects; expected duration 8 months. Opened 7 July 2026; single-stage deadline extended to 1 December 2026, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Appendix 8 of the Chips JU Work Programme (GB_2026.139, section 5.2.2, Topic A1 Expected Outcomes and Scope) funds AI chip demonstrators by European fabless chip designers for data-centre computing. No project file is close: the topic concerns semiconductor design and benchmarking with no energy-system application, so it does not touch TenneT's field.
